verdict.rationale: Weaviate's own docs and README confirm it runs vector similarity search over stored embeddings, including pre-computed vectors, combined with keyword search. Nothing in the pack shows the approximate nearest-neighbor indexing approach or any way to configure distance metrics, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of ANN index types (e.g., HNSW parameters), configurable distance metrics (cosine/dot/L2 etc.), independent or hands-on corroboration of similarity-search behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run approximate nearest-neighbor similarity search over embeddings with configurable distance metrics

citations.quote: By indexing data with vectors, Weaviate supports searches based on both semantic similarity and keywords.
It combines vector similarity search with keyword filtering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and reranking in a single query interface.
direct import of pre-computed vector embeddings
Weaviate is an open-source vector database (Go) that stores objects, vectors, and inverted indexes
